spec: Exercise the complete product against the release gates and acceptance matrix in docs/test-impact/design.md sections 11, 13 and 14. Add targeted fixtures for the supported ecosystems, including callbacks, reflection, shared fixtures, generated code, resources and cross-project dependencies. Compare selections with full-suite runs on representative histories and deliberately introduced failures, recording limitations and fixing or tracking defects as appropriate. Measure end-to-end snapshot, graph, discovery, setup and execution costs against full runs, selected unit count and fallback frequency. Document reproducible evidence and supported boundaries; do not claim the comparison proves all dependency kinds are modeled. The entire design remains binding. Work directly in this fork for an eventual upstream pull request; no separate product repository or subtree.
title: Validate end-to-end safety and measure sparse testing
